steps_unproved: The swap reader is a new module-level _swap_free_mib() in launchers/proofs/test_superclaude_memory_scope.py returning SwapFree from /proc/meminfo in MiB (kB // 1024); NEED_SWAP_MIB = 512 sits beside _BALLOON with a one-line comment: the balloon touches 400 MiB under a 100M cap, so escaping needs ~300 MiB of swap, and 512 is that plus margin, CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

The unswapped arm (the check named 'the same cap WITHOUT MemorySwapMax does not contain (why the swap limit is not optional)') moves into its own module-level function _unswapped_arm(), called from half_one_mechanism() where the arm stands today. It reads free = _swap_free_mib() first; if free < NEED_SWAP_MIB it calls check(<the same name>, False, f'precondition unmet: SwapFree {free} MiB < {NEED_SWAP_MIB} MiB needed — this arm cannot tell contained from killed for lack of swap') and returns without running the balloon; otherwise it runs _run_ballooned(['-p', 'MemoryMax=100M']) and checks 'REACHED' in stdout exactly as today. Never a PASS and never a skip when the precondition is unmet, CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

_run_ballooned puts '-p', 'CollectMode=inactive-or-failed' into the systemd-run argv directly after '--quiet' and before the caller's limits, so a failed balloon scope is collected on exit (the mark f04d5ef26a48 gave launchers/superclaude). Nothing else in the file changes, CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
